# Virat Mohan

> Operator, chartered accountant and founder based in Gurugram, Haryana, India. Two decades across finance, hospitality and technology. Builds the operating layer between capital and execution.

Virat Mohan's thesis: AI has made capability cheap and judgment scarce. The businesses that compound are the ones that put humans in front of the machine, not behind it.

## Career

- 2008–2015 — KPMG London; statutory audits including HSBC; qualified ICAEW chartered accountant.
- 2015–2020 — Pita Pit; regional director to CEO across India, UK, UAE, KSA and Singapore; grew the India estate from 6 to 21 units and quadrupled revenue.
- 2020–2022 — CloudKitchens®; built 122 cloud kitchens across three cities in under 24 months; 90% occupancy within 12 months with 100+ enterprise F&B brands; led APAC customer success for 1,000+ brands.
- 2022–2025 — Daryaganj (CFBO); raised $2M in equity and NCDs; featured on Shark Tank India; valuation doubled to ₹150 Cr in 18 months. Foodlink Chief of Staff through an ₹80 Cr pre-IPO round and DRHP.
- 2024–present — Opportunities Unlocked LLP and ClarityHQ; AI-native growth services delivered by a distributed human network.

## Education

- London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)
- Cass Business School, City University London
- ICAEW (chartered accountant)

## Advises on

Commercial and operational due diligence; financial modelling and unit economics; capital allocation; GCC and India market entry; operational turnarounds; DRHP and IPO readiness. Geographic focus: India, UAE, UK.
